actionType.description:
The type of the action. This identifies it so it can be consumed by
{@link Ann.UiSdlReducer} and {@link Ann.UiSdlEpic}.
NOTE: The real field name is `type` but it is reserved

payload.description:
The data to be sent as payload. Consumers of this action
can use this as parameters.

error.description: If true, it means this action contains error information

title:
A UiSdlReduxAction object represents an action to be applied in the Redux Store.
It is sent from a component through a {@link Ann.UiTrigger} annotated function
and is consumed by a {@link Ann.UiSdlReducer} or {@link Ann.UiSdlEpic}
annotated function.

It contains a `type` field that identifies the type of action and payload
data.

@see https://redux.js.org/basics/actions
name: UiSdlReduxAction
